decisions.decision: SagaContext rejects null values (IllegalArgumentException); Optional.empty() means never written
decisions.why: Optional cannot carry null; keeps FR-004 unambiguous without adding API surface
decisions.rejected: hasState(name) method; treating stored null as absent

decisions.decision: InMemorySagaContext defensively copies Map values on putState
decisions.why: caller mutations after putState must not leak into stored state, matching a storage round-trip

decisions.decision: InvalidSagaTransitionException exposes notFound and terminal static factories
decisions.why: two distinct rejection causes with consistent messages, no public constructor sprawl

decisions.decision: Terminal statuses are COMPLETED and FAILED
decisions.why: advance/complete on either must be rejected per FR-006

decisions.decision: The @EndSaga pre-check before complete is the responsibility of the caller (engine), not SagaLifecycle
decisions.why: SagaInstance has no current-step field, so the contract cannot know which step is executing
decisions.rejected: adding a current-step field to the SPI SagaInstance in this feature
